items.title: Widerspruch against contribution assessment
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen die Beitragsfestsetzung ist binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe möglich; Sie können ihn schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der IKK Nordmuster, Innungsplatz 7, 24539 Musterneumünster, einlegen.
items.computation: Document dated Friday 2027-10-01, sent by post. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a letter sent by domestic post is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the third day after posting, unless that day falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, in which case it shifts to the next business day. Assuming posting on the document date (01.10.2027, Fri): day 1 = Sat 02.10., day 2 = Sun 03.10. (also a holiday, Tag der Deutschen Einheit, but already Sunday), day 3 = Mon 04.10.2027, a normal business day, so Bekanntgabe = 04.10.2027. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist (§ 84 SGG) begins the day after the triggering event (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), but under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a month-long period ends on the day of the last month whose calendar number matches the day of the triggering event (04.). One month after 04.10.2027 is 04.11.2027 (Thursday), which is not a weekend day or NRW public holiday, so no shift is needed under § 193 BGB. Deadline = 04.11.2027.

items.title: First direct debit of new monthly contribution (Nov. 2027 contribution)
items.quote: Den Beitrag buchen wir wie bisher zum 15. des Folgemonats von Ihrem Konto ab.
items.computation: New monthly contribution of EUR 451,54 applies from 01.11.2027. The letter states the contribution for a given month is debited on the 15th of the following month ('Folgemonats'). The first contribution affected by this new calculation is for November 2027, so it is debited on 15.12.2027 (Wednesday), which is not a weekend day or NRW public holiday.

warnings: The recipient's address printed on the letter (73728 Musterlingen am Neckar) is in Baden-Württemberg, not Nordrhein-Westfalen; per instructions NRW holidays were used for the deadline calculation, but if the person's actual residence/mailing address is in Baden-Württemberg, Baden-Württemberg's public holidays should be checked as well (no difference arose for the dates computed here, but this should be verified).

The direct-debit payment date (15.12.2027) is an automatic bank collection ('Lastschrift'), not a date the person must actively act on, other than ensuring sufficient account balance; please verify the account used is correct and has not been changed.
